=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2396-2414 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When a routed planning scope block adds `ai:scope-blocked` (with GH_PAT), the `issues: labeled` trigger in internal-workflow-failure-heal.yml starts the workflow-failure-heal reporter, and `skip_reason()` (workflow_failure_heal.py:3180-3222) has no exemption for a planning-time scope block.
  WHY: Every routed planning block, which is a scope decision and not a workflow failure, sends extra API reads, a cross-repo heal dispatch and a model diagnosis that run alongside the unblock judge. This contradicts the §15 no-new-API-calls constraint and the README/changelog cost notes. The label is also added before the marker comment is posted. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:904-909 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Every routed planning scope block gets the same fingerprint. `unblock_evidence` (unblock_judge.sh:1396-1404) uses the first line of the comment, which is always "Planning blocked: human input required." (plan.yml:2463), and the SCOPE_MISSING paths appear only in the base64 marker.
  WHY: Once one `override_guard` is granted, `decide()` treats that (stop, fingerprint) as used across the item and project, so later planning scope blocks are not offered `override_guard` and stall again. All flagging reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disagreed in its notes, calling this inherited existing behaviour rather than a regression.
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:89-91, 134-139 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The scope-only routing check counts `BLOCKED:` lines and checks for a self-check blocker, but never checks that the BLOCKED reason is about scope.
  WHY: Output such as `BLOCKED: needs a credential` plus a valid `SCOPE_MISSING:` line gets routed to the scope-override flow, which contradicts Goal 4 (other planning blocks behave exactly as today). Severity disagreement: gemini and luna rated it MAJOR; minimax and glm rated it NIT because the paths are still re-validated and the prompt rule is the existing guard.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:829-836 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Because of the `and not extra_blocked` guard, the splice `approve_ops[:-1] + extra_blocked + approve_ops[-1:]` is dead code that always returns `approve_ops`.
  WHY: The comment at 829-833 ("The label goes before the resume command...") describes behaviour this branch never performs, which invites a wrong future edit that could bring back approval of a superseded plan. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:1051-1060 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Validate planning phase label" comment still says "(fail closed; no API call)", but line 1060 now runs `gh_retry gh api user --jq .login`.
  WHY: The comment is the audit trail for the step's §14/§15 API budget, and it contradicts the code, the README `PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK_ROUTING_ENABLED` row and the changelog fragment. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- README.md:309 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `JUDGE_FILES_TOUCHED_COMPANIONS_ENABLED` row lists only reason=disabled|no_block|helper_failed and leaves out the new `reason=entry_mismatch`, which scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh `apply_judge_files_touched_companions` emits.
  WHY: `JUDGE_SCOPE_COMPANIONS` is a contractual log prefix, so anyone filtering logs on the documented reason set misses this skip case. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2408-2414 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: When the combined label edit fails, the step clears SCOPE_ROUTE_ACTIVE but does not roll back a partially applied `ai:scope-blocked`, unlike the comment-failure path at 2486-2491.
  WHY: The issue can be left latched with `ai:scope-blocked` and no marker: the ledger returns "missing", answer-release returns "no_rejection", and implement later refuses dispatch. Rated NIT.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2360-2364 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The helper-missing fallback logs `reason=helper_failed` without first checking `PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK_ROUTING_ENABLED`.
  WHY: When routing is disabled and the helper is not staged, the log contradicts the documented `reason=disabled` contract (README.md:310, agents.d fragment). `scope_routed=false` is still correct. Rated NIT.
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:2358 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The log statement records helper_failed when routing is disabled.
  WHY: When PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK_ROUTING_ENABLED is false and the helper is missing, the log says helper_failed instead of reason=disabled, which contradicts the logging contract. Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "§15: no new GitHub API calls. Companion entries are added to the body before the existing `gh issue create`. The marker is part of the comment plan.yml already posts, and `ai:scope-blocked` is added in the same `gh issue edit` that adds `ai:blocked` today. The label is created with the existing `ensure_label_exists` helper only when it is absent; that helper's read already runs for `ai:blocked`."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/plan.yml "Validate planning phase label" step; scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh `answer-release` mode
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: A new REST read `PLAN_SCOPE_PIPELINE_LOGIN="$(gh_retry gh api user --jq .login 2>/dev/null || true)"` sits at .github/workflows/plan.yml:1060, and answer-release fails closed with `reason=identity_unavailable` without it (scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:236-238). Reviewers say no cached identity is reused (plan.yml:370 is not exported; 1316, 3447, 3554 and 3589 run later). README.md:310 and changelog.d/9534-judge-scope-gaps.md were rewritten to approve the extra call instead of meeting the constraint. Proposed fix: read the login once in "Fetch issue metadata" (plan.yml:895-903) and export it via $GITHUB_ENV. Rated MAJOR (confidence 4-5). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5's notes deliberately did not re-raise this (CONSOLIDATOR_OVERRIDDEN iss_99cc9c081cbcbd0a, kept as the cost of the login-based trust fix).
- requirement: "The new header without a marker is treated as malformed and does not offer `override_guard`."
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_ledger.py `latest_rejection`; tests/test_unblock_judge.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The planning header is appended after the comment's first line, but `latest_rejection` recognises header-only comments only when `lines[0]` is in `GUARD_REJECTION_HEADERS` (`scripts/unblock_ledger.py:605-608`). A planning header without a marker therefore returns `reason=missing`, not `reason=malformed`, and the added test asserts `missing`. Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:829-836 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Because of the `and not extra_blocked` guard, `extra_blocked` is always [] in this branch, so the splice returns `approve_ops` unchanged. The comment still describes inserting the ai:blocked removal before `/approved`.
  WHY: It does not fail today, but the comment misstates the invariant, and a later edit that drops the guard would bring back approval of a superseded plan. Fix: return `_approve(item, ctx["labels"], present)` and move the comment next to line 837.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2408-2414 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed combined label edit clears SCOPE_ROUTE_ACTIVE but does not roll back a partially applied ai:scope-blocked. The comment-post failure path at 2486-2491 does have a rollback.
  WHY: The issue is left with ai:scope-blocked and no marker: the ledger returns "missing", answer-release returns "no_rejection", and implement's "Validate approval phase" refuses dispatch. Fix: a best-effort `--remove-label 'ai:scope-blocked'` (about 4 lines).
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:1051-1053 (vs line 1060) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The "no API call" wording is kept above the new `gh_retry gh api user --jq .login` read at line 1060.
  WHY: It contradicts the code, the README `PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK_ROUTING_ENABLED` row and the changelog fragment, which is the step's §14 audit trail. Remove "; no API call".
- README.md:309 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `JUDGE_FILES_TOUCHED_COMPANIONS_ENABLED` row's reason list leaves out the new `reason=entry_mismatch` (orchestrate_poll_process.sh apply_judge_files_touched_companions; agents.d/9534-judge-scope-gaps.md).
  WHY: For a contractual log prefix, operators filtering on the README reason set miss the entry_mismatch skip. Add `\|entry_mismatch`.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2398-2412 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Adding ai:scope-blocked with the PAT triggers "Internal: AI Workflow Failure Heal" (internal-workflow-failure-heal.yml 3-5, 19-22). workflow_failure_heal_report.sh (99-100, 125, 140, 166-172, 251-255) fetches the issue, comments, runs and user, then dispatches a heal report, and skip_reason (workflow_failure_heal.py 3180-3222) has no exemption.
  WHY: Every routed planning block also sends a heal report and a model diagnosis, so two handlers work on one item. This is undocumented in the README/changelog, breaks the §15 no-new-API-calls constraint, and the label is added at 2408 before the marker is posted at 2484. Fix: skip in the reporter when LABEL=ai:scope-blocked and the issue also carries ai:blocked, or document the cost.
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/plan.yml "Handle blocked planning output" (2408-2414): in the failure branch, run a best-effort `--remove-label 'ai:scope-blocked'` (4 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_report.sh after the issue fetch (110-122): skip, logging reason=planning_scope_block, when LABEL=ai:scope-blocked and ai:blocked is present (4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2.
- NOTES (not raised as findings, 4 related items): the `gh api user` read was kept on purpose (CONSOLIDATOR_OVERRIDDEN iss_99cc9c081cbcbd0a); the shared ledger fingerprint is existing behaviour (unblock_judge.sh:1396-1404, unblock_ledger.py:904), not a regression; no check that the BLOCKED reason is scope-related is accepted by the issue's Risks section; the helper_failed vs disabled log wording predates the last run.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
